metadata.title: बेर की बिरयानी यानि आदिवासी लेठा । How Ho Adivasi cook rice & berries । The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we take you to a small village of the Ho Tribe in Odisha. The Ho Tribe is a clan of Munda adivasis only.
In this video, we are cooking a very special dish, which they offer to their Gods. 

#Ho_tribe #बेर_बिरयानी #The_Tribal_Kitchen
